purpose: Deterministic preparation of the EPA AQS 2021-2024 development set without access to 2025 concentration content.

time_axis.stored_representation: timezone-naive datetime64[ns] whose values denote UTC
time_axis.calendar_clock: AQS local standard time, fixed UTC-07:00
time_axis.amendment_reason: The development audit found that AQS date_local/time_local equals GMT minus seven hours for every selected row. America/Denver civil time disagrees during daylight-saving months, so fixed local standard time reproduces the source clock without DST duplicates or gaps.

measurement_policy.accepted_measurements: finite numeric sample_measurement values returned by AQS
measurement_policy.qualifiers: retain finite measurements regardless of qualifier and report qualifier prevalence; nonfinite or absent measurements remain missing
measurement_policy.negative_measurements: retain as reported instrument values; do not clamp or reinterpret them as missing
measurement_policy.concurrent_monitor_merge: median across finite POC/method readings sharing station, pollutant, and UTC hour
measurement_policy.merge_rationale: The development audit found duplicate multiplicity at most two; the median is deterministic and limits dependence on a single collocated monitor without selecting methods using outcome performance.

split_bounds_utc.operational_lookback_rule: Validation inputs may use observations before the first validation target, including the embargo interval, but no embargo timestamp is a training or validation target.

missingness.fallback_after_limit: training station-pollutant median, represented by zero after scaling
missingness.time_since_observation: recomputed causally after every experimental outage; log1p applied at model input

training_only_transforms.scaler: station-pollutant median and interquartile range; pollutant-wide training fallback for empty/constant cells
training_only_transforms.exceedance_pooling: each pollutant pooled across all selected stations in the training split
training_only_transforms.mase_denominator: station-pollutant mean absolute seasonal difference over jointly observed training pairs
